## Description

As name + DOB (and identifiers) are typed, call /v1/patients/duplicate-check (debounced) and show "Possible match" inline. On the Review step, a side-by-side NEW vs EXISTING panel ("Attention · possible existing record. Matched on name + date of birth. A shared phone number alone is never treated as a match.") with actions: Not the same person · continue / Use existing record / Request merge review (P-03). Save is blocked ("Resolve duplicate to save") until one is chosen.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A candidate is suggested when name similarity + identical DOB, or an exact identifier (ABHA/EID/passport) match exists; phone-only matches never produce a suggestion (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Duplicate-check responses show initials, age and masked identifiers only, never full details of the other record until "Use existing record" is chosen.
- [ ] **AC3.** Save remains disabled until the receptionist resolves the duplicate; the decision and actor are audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** "Use existing record" opens that patient without creating a new one; "Request merge review" creates a merge request (MDV-P1-017).
- [ ] **AC5.** p95 duplicate-check latency < 300 ms on staging data of 50,000 synthetic patients.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
